behaviour.title: Replace the Twilio sender number
behaviour.detail: The from number is +15550100000, which is in the reserved fictional 555-01xx range and is not a number anyone can send from. Twilio rejects it. Put a number on your own account here, or a Messaging Service SID.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "ONCALL_NUMBER" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

behaviour.title: Point the HTTP calls at your own endpoint
behaviour.detail: The URL "api.example.com" is illustrative - example.com is reserved for documentation and resolves to nothing useful. Replace it with the service you are actually calling, and set that service's authentication on the node.

behaviour.title: The routed arms are not equivalent - the 'standard' arm takes no action of its own
behaviour.detail: Route by Work Type splits the run. The 'priority' arm ends at Fast-Track 'priority' + Alert, which posts a Slack message to #automation. The 'standard' arm goes to Delegate 'standard' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Standard Job - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Standard Job before relying on that arm.

behaviour.title: Re-running will duplicate rows, despite the node name
behaviour.detail: "Update Changed Rows" is named as an update or upsert but runs operation insert, which always writes a new record. A redelivered webhook, a manual retry or an overlapping scheduled run therefore creates a second copy. Add a unique key on the destination, or switch the operation, before you rely on it.

This is a defect in the template; tell us and we will fix or refund it.

bindings.title: Import "lib: Post-Process Metrics" and select it on Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow
bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Post-Process Metrics, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-post-process-metrics.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.
